title: Automatic range split and rebalance
statement: The system shall partition the ordered keyspace into contiguous ranges, automatically split ranges exceeding a configurable size, and rebalance replicas across nodes without rejecting client requests.
rationale: Range partitioning keeps a node and its adjacency together; hash partitioning would scatter one-hop reads.

acceptance_criteria.text: Adding a node to a cluster under YCSB workload A results in replica counts per node within ±10% of the mean within 1 hour, with zero failed client requests.
The Jepsen-style suite with continuous splits finds zero serializability anomalies.
